blocks.html: An object used to allow specifying flexible queries with and/or conditions.

types.name: $and
types.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "and" condition.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of items to retrieve.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip before retrieving the returned items.

children.name: order
children.description: The field to sort by and in which order.

children.name: with_deleted
children.description: Whether to include soft-deleted items in the results.

children.name: id
children.description: Filter by sales channel ID(s).

children.name: q
children.description: Query or keywords to search the sales channel's searchable fields.

children.name: name
children.description: Filter by sales channel name.

children.name: description
children.description: Filter by sales channel description.

children.name: is_disabled
children.description: Filter by whether the sales channel is disabled.

children.name: location_id
children.description:
Filter by the ID(s) of the location(s) to retrieve the
sales channels for.

children.name: publishable_key_id
children.description:
Filter by the ID(s) of the publishable key(s) to retrieve the
sales channels for.

children.name: created_at
children.description: Filter by the date when the sales channel was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: Filter by the date when the sales channel was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: Filter by the date when the sales channel was deleted.
